_metadata.description: Pointing EM's loop at the fleet: importance-aware scheduling, cross-type intelligence, coverage-gap robustness, and unattended multi-scenario runs (OT-P1-002, OT-P1-006).

requirements.title: Importance-aware task selection
requirements.description: Pending-task selection weighs composed scenario importance times maturity gap, with normalization and a system-required floor.

requirements.title: Degraded importance inputs are flagged, not fatal
requirements.description: Missing importance inputs (centrality, freshness, etc.) mark the composition as degraded instead of failing scheduling.

requirements.title: Skill-coverage gaps are reported, unactionable findings skipped
requirements.description: The coverage reporter surfaces dimensions whose findings no skill can close (e.g. dependencies), and the selector falls through to the next actionable dimension instead of stalling — required for unattended fleet runs.

requirements.title: Unattended fleet runs: point at scenarios A/B/C and poll
requirements.description: An operator can enqueue improver tasks for a set of old-template scenarios with a shadow-enabled profile and let the loop run unattended to a terminal state per scenario (objective met or honest halt), monitoring progress without intervening. Prerequisites: EM-BASE-005 (measurement isolation) and a dependencies steer skill for the R1 hard gate.

validation.ref: Attended pilot: EM steers 2+ scenarios end-to-end with shadow engagements, zero operator interventions mid-run
